## About
Express Tires & Services is a tire shop and general mechanic in Hialeah. We sell new and used tires, and we can help with everything from an oil change to an engine change, on both foreign and domestic vehicles.
We want you to get the quality you'd expect from a dealership, in a more personal and friendly place. We only do the work that's needed to fix your problem, and we explain it before we start.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating from 254 Google reviews. We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday.

## Services
- Tire and wheel services: New and used tires to fit your car and your budget.
- Brake repair: Brake work to keep your car stopping the way it should.
- Oil change: Conventional, high mileage, synthetic blend or full synthetic oil, plus a check of the essential systems and components of your vehicle.
- Car A/C recharge: We clear out the old Freon, recharge the system with new Freon, then check pressure and temperature control to make sure everything is working.
- Engine diagnostics: Diagnostic testing to find the root cause of the problem so we're not guessing at the repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We handle foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We carry both new and used tires.

Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: Yes, on Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
